part: Lower bulkhead (gear box lower half) of the Carten T410R, stock part NBA249
coordinate_system: Origin at the centre of the 4 bottom holes on the bottom face. x along the diff axis (across the car), y along the pinion axis, +y toward the pinion and the centre shaft, z = 0 bottom face (contact face to the chassis plate), +z up.
design: Prismatic part in the style of the upper bulkhead: the footprint of the upper part, extruded to the parting face, with a flat contact face on the chassis plate and one straight chamfer per side below the wings (space for the pivot blocks of the wishbones). Below the chamfers: a rectangular block under the pinion, the 4 screw bosses and the sway bar tabs. The only curved faces are the bores, the cavities, the bosses and the ends of the tabs.

source_codes.caliper: Caliper measurement of the stock part by the owner of the car (measurement sheet, number in the note)
source_codes.manual: T410R instruction manual (bearing sizes, screw sizes)
source_codes.user: Information from the owner of the car
source_codes.photo: Estimate from photos of the stock part with rulers at the height of the part, accuracy approx. +-0.5 mm
source_codes.derived: Calculated from caliper values and part sizes
source_codes.design: Design choice of the model, free
source_codes.test: Result of the first test print of the lower part (fit of the stock diff and pinion)

bottom_hole_dx.note: No. 1: 31.2 - 3.2. The photo of the bottom face confirms the ratio 28.0 / 20.0 within 0.3 %. The chassis plate CAD has 28.17 (H03 to H06, H28 to H31).

bottom_hole_dy.note: No. 2: 23.2 - 3.2. The chassis plate CAD has 20.22.

bottom_hole_d.note: Tap drill for M3. Stock part: 3.2 at the entry (no. 3). The screws are M3x8 countersunk from below through the 2 mm plate, so 6 mm of the screw engage in the part.

bottom_hole_depth.note: Drill depth. Thread depth for CNC: 6.5. Stock part: 6.25 (no. 3).

axis_z.note: No. 4: height of the parting face above the bottom face. The diff axis and the pinion axis lie in the parting face (half bores).

diff_axis_y.note: Position of the diff axis in y. Photo with the diff installed: the diff axis is 0.5 mm from the middle of the top bosses toward the pinion. Accuracy approx. +-0.7 mm.

body_half_width.note: Inner face of the lip 15.35 (no. 14) plus lip thickness 1.89 (no. 13). The width over the outer faces is 34.48. No. 10 measured 34.2 (0.28 less).

body_y_outer_end.note: Outer end of the part, same as the upper part (flush ends). The stock lower part ends at -28.42 (no. 16); the sway bar tabs protrude beyond the end.

body_y_pinion_end.note: Pinion end of the body at the parting face, same as the upper part. The half cylinder over the outer pinion bearing protrudes to 27.9.

body_corner_r.note: Corner radius of the footprint (top view), same as the upper part.

base_half_length.note: Half length in y of the contact face on the chassis plate. In front of and behind it, the pivot blocks of the wishbones are mounted below the chamfers.

base_height.note: No. 22: height of the vertical end faces of the contact block. The chamfers start at this height.

end_face_h.note: Height of the end faces at the outer end and the pinion end below the parting face. Each chamfer runs straight from the contact block (base_half_length, base_height) to the end face. The chamfers lie above the side profile of the previous design (photo of the stock part), so the space for the pivot blocks is not reduced.

case_cavity_r.note: Radius of the cavity around the diff axis for the diff case, between the two bearing seats. Test print with 12.5: the diff case touched the wall on the outer side (opposite the pinion). Increased by 1.0. Bottom at axis_z - 13.5 = 3.7 mm.

ring_gear_side.note: Side of the 42T ring gear: +1 = +x side. Confirmed by the photo with the diff installed: seen from above with the pinion pointing to the viewer, the ring gear is on the left. The ring gear is on the same side of the bulkhead at the front and at the rear.

ring_recess_r.note: Radius of the deepening for the 42T ring gear: ring gear outer diameter 31.93 (no. 27) / 2 + 0.43 clearance.

ring_recess_x_inner.note: Inner end of the deepening (|x|). Photo with the diff installed: tooth tips of the ring gear approx. 5.0 from the diff centre.

ring_recess_x_outer.note: Outer end of the deepening (|x|) = inner end of the bearing seat (15.35 - 4.0). Photo with the diff installed: back face of the ring gear approx. 9.4 from the diff centre. Wall to the bottom holes: 1.4.

floor_z.note: Floor thickness below the deepening for the ring gear (axis_z - ring_recess_r), outside the floor opening.

ring_floor_opening_half_length.note: Through opening in the floor below the ring gear deepening, half length in y around the diff axis (opening 5.0 long). The stock part has an extra deepening of approx. 5 mm length below the ring gear with approx. 0.7 mm more space (user). Test print: the ring gear did not rotate freely. The floor below the deepening is 0.8 thick, so the extra deepening is made as a through opening; the chassis plate closes it. Lowest tooth of the ring gear to the chassis plate: 1.23. Over the 5 mm, the ring gear rises by approx. 0.2.

ring_floor_opening_r.note: Corner radius of the floor opening (top view, end mill radius).

diff_bearing.note: Diff bearings NBA299, d x D x B. Stock part: half bore 15.6 wide at the parting face (no. 11). The model uses 15.0 for the bearing fit.

diff_lip_inner_x.note: No. 14: spacing of the inner faces of the two lips 30.7. The diff with both bearings measures 30.0 (no. 28): 0.7 axial play. The bearings are held only by the lips on the outside and by the diff on the inside.

diff_seat_width.note: The half bore runs 4.0 inward from the lip and then opens into the gear cavity. The seat is limited only by the outer lip, there is no inner shoulder.

diff_lip_d.note: No. 12: opening of the outer lip. Lip thickness 1.89 (no. 13, no. 15 was the lip again).

pinion_bearing.note: Pinion bearings NBA298, d x D x B, 2 pieces. Stock part: half bore 10.5 wide at the parting face (no. 18). The model uses 10.0 for the bearing fit.

pinion_seat_y_inner.note: Inner end of the pinion seat (the half bore of 10 opens into the pinion pocket, no shoulder): diff axis + 15.6 / 2 (no. 11) + 19.6 (no. 17) - 9.25 (no. 19). Photo with the diff installed: inner pinion bearing approx. 18.3 from the diff axis.

pinion_seat_length.note: No. 19: inner end of the seat to the end face of the pinion housing. Two bearings of 4.0 and the rib of 1.25 between them.

pinion_rib_t.note: Rib between the two pinion bearings, the only axial stop in the seat. Second test print: 0.35 thinner than 1.25 (user). The face toward the pinion stays at pinion_seat_y_inner + 4.0, the outer bearing seat is 0.35 longer than the bearing.

pinion_rib_d.note: Opening of the rib: 0.3 smaller in radius than the bearing seat. The stock part has only a fraction of a millimetre, just enough to keep the two bearings apart (user, second test print).

pinion_housing_r.note: Half width and depth of the narrow step of the block under the pinion seats (seat radius 5.0, wall 1.6). The step continues beyond the end of the footprint over the outer pinion bearing.

pinion_pocket_r.note: Radius of the pocket for the pinion gear: outer diameter 14.1 (no. 29) / 2 + 1.2 clearance. Test print with 7.75: more space required for the pinion.

pinion_pocket_wall.note: Wall around the pinion pocket. The block under the pinion is (pinion_pocket_r + 1.5) wide on each side and reaches (pinion_pocket_r + 1.5) below the parting face.

pinion_pocket_y_min.note: Start of the pinion pocket in y. The pocket runs to the inner end of the pinion seat.

top_boss_d.note: No. 6: outer diameter of the 4 bosses for the screws of the upper bulkhead.

top_boss_protrusion.note: No. 5 (19.62) minus no. 4 (17.2): height of the bosses above the parting face.

top_boss_x_pinion.note: No. 7: spacing 18.7 (21.8 - 3.1). Top view photo: 18.9. Screws M3x10, button head.

top_boss_x_outer.note: No. 8: spacing 21.6 (24.3 - 2.7). Top view photo: 21.9. Screws M3x8, button head.

top_boss_y_pinion.note: No. 9: spacing along 42.6, centred 0.5 mm from the diff axis toward the outer side (photo with the diff installed).

top_boss_z_base.note: Lower end of the 4 boss columns below the chamfers: boss top 19.62 - hole depth 7.0 - 1.5.

top_hole_d.note: Tap drill for M3. Stock part: 3.1 (pinion side), 2.7 (outer side).

top_hole_depth.note: Drill depth from the top of the bosses.

swaybar_hole_y.note: No. 24: 7.4 from the outer top boss holes. Bottom view photo: -28.6.

swaybar_tab_r.note: Outer radius of the tabs around the sway bar holes.

swaybar_tab_t.note: No. 25: thickness of the tabs. The top face of the tabs is the parting face (side view photo, to be confirmed).

swaybar_hole_d.note: Tap drill for M3. Stock part: 2.6.

print_seat_allowance.note: Test print only: added to the bearing seat diameters.

print_hole_d.note: Test print only: diameter of all M3 holes for self-tapping screws.
